full_judgment: 8. Mr Rahman further submits that the Court below failed to take into judicial notice that whole power system will simply collapse if the demand and supply of electricity is not coordinated by any competent authority. Accordingly, it is the burden of Quantum to prove that BPDB and such other competent authority engaged in this regard actually did not demand electricity on hourly basis which is contrary to the general presumption and, as such, the order is liable to be set aside. He further submits that a direction may be given to the parties to resolve their dispute through commission under section 40(1) of the Bangladesh Energy Regulatory Commission Act, 2003.
